feed.title: HeatWatch
feed.subtitle: Where heat is breaking records, who it is reaching, what the rules are about to require, and what can be done about it.

entry.title: A flash flood killed a 102-year-old woman in Spain as storms returned to the same warm sea
entry.summary: A second wave of storms fed by an unusually warm Mediterranean killed a 102-year-old woman in Madrigueras, Albacete, on 3 October, trapped by floodwater over a metre deep inside her home. — Sources: Regional emergency services, via the Olive Press, 3 October 2026 · AEMET

entry.title: Southern California's heat wave became the longest October extreme heat warning on record
entry.summary: Downtown Los Angeles, Long Beach, Santa Ana and Anaheim each set all-time October heat records on 2 October, with Los Angeles reaching 103 degrees Fahrenheit. — Sources: National Weather Service · CBS Los Angeles, 2 October 2026 · The Watchers, 3 October 2026

entry.title: Malaysia and Singapore have almost no legal recourse against Indonesia over wildfire haze
entry.summary: Haze from Indonesian wildfires has closed schools and driven respiratory complaints across Malaysia and Singapore for more than a month. — Sources: The Japan Times, 1 October 2026 · The Jakarta Post, 1 October 2026

entry.title: European Union ministers will discuss the Quality Jobs Act's workplace safety update on 19 October
entry.summary: A Council of the European Union document confirms the European Commission's Quality Jobs Act proposal, which would update workplace safety rules including heat exposure, remains due before the end of 2026. — Sources: Council of the European Union, document 13885/26, 2 October 2026
